Date of Adoption and Second Reading at a Public Meeting: September 14, 2020

WHEREAS, the Mayor and Town Council of the Town of Sharpsburg now find that vehicles with more than six (6) wheels, including trailers, or a vehicle weight in excess of 12,000 pounds GVW, are large, noisy, difficult to maneuver, cause damage to roads and create visual obstacles of other drivers on residential streets; and

WHEREAS, the Mayor and Town Council find that the presence of vehicles with more than six (6) wheels, including trailers, or a vehicle weight in excess of 12,000 pounds GVW, detract from the Town of Sharpsburg citizens’ safety and cause the deterioration of the town of Sharpsburg’s environmental quality on its residential streets; and

WHEREAS, the Mayor and Town Council desire to enhance the safety and environmental quality of the Town of Sharpsburg; and

WHEREAS, the Mayor and Town Council desire to protect the health, safety, morals, and welfare of the citizens of the Town of Sharpsburg and all those who travel on the Town’s streets.
7: Sharpsburg Code of Ordinances is hereby amended by inserting therein the following:
8:
weight in excess of 12,000 pounds GVW are restricted.

- (a) All vehicles with more than six (6) wheels including trailers, or a vehicle weight in excess of 12,000 pounds GVW are prohibited from traveling upon any part of

1

Main Street, Church Street, Stovall Street, Haines Trail and Terrentine Street. As used in this ordinance Terrentine Street shall begin at Highway 54 and shall end at the corner of Sharpsburg-McCollum Road.

- (b) Vehicles with more than six (6) wheels shall include vehicles pulling trailers, in which case the wheels of the vehicle and the trailer shall be included.

- (c) Exceptions to said prohibited vehicles shall be recreational vehicles, vehicles pulling recreational trailers and vehicles pulling boat trailers. School buses, emergency vehicles, vehicles used for relocation of personal property and solid waste collection vehicles performing the particular purposes for which the vehicles are designed are also exempt.

- (d) Prohibited vehicles may travel on Main Street, Church Street, Stovall Street, Haines Trail and Terrentine Street for the purpose of making active deliveries and/or making active pickups of goods or the active provision of services at locations on Main Street Church Street, Stovall Street, Haines Trail and Terrentine Street. Prohibited vehicles may also travel on Main Street, Church Street, Stovall Street, Haines Trail and Terrentine Street for the purpose of making active deliveries and/or making active pickups of goods or the active provision of services at locations which can only be accessed by Main Street, Church Street, Stovall Street, Haines Trail and Terrentine Street; however, there shall be no through traffic of vehicles with more than six (6) wheels, including trailers, or a vehicle weight in excess of 12,000 pounds GVW.

- (e) Prohibited vehicles not involved in active deliveries, active pickups, or the active provision of services may not be parked on or along Main Street, Church Street, Stovall Street, Haines Trail or Terrentine Street, or on lots or parcels contiguous to, and accessed by Main Street, Church Street, Stovall Street, Haines Trail or Terrentine Street.

(f} Prohibited vehicles include all vehicles designed to be operated on more than six (6) wheels including trailers, regardless of whether or not all such wheels are actually in use.

- (2) Violations of this article may be enforced and citations issued thereon by code violation officers of the Town of Sharpsburg, and said citation shall be returnable to the municipal court of the Town of Sharpsburg or to the Magistrates Court of Coweta County and shall be tried in said court.

- (h) Any person, corporation, partnership or other entity violating this section shall be tried before the municipal court of the Town of Sharpsburg or the Magistrates Court of Coweta County and shall, upon conviction, be subject to up to the maximum fine and/or the maximum term of imprisonment set out in Section 6.13 of the Town’s Charter.
9: This Ordinance shall become immediately effective upon its second reading and adoption by the Town Council.
10: The Preamble of this Ordinance shall be construed to be, and is hereby incorporated by reference as is fully set out herein.
11: The sections, paragraphs, sentences, clauses, and phrases of this Ordinance are severable, and if any phrase, sentence, paragraph, or section of this Ordinance shall be declared illegal by the valid judgment or decree of any court of competent jurisdiction, such an illegality shall not affect any of the remaining phrases, clauses, sentences, paragraphs, and sections of this Ordinance.
12: All ordinances and parts of ordinances in conflict herewith are hereby expressly repealed.
13:
This Ordinance shall be Codified at Chapter 84, Section 1 of the Town’s Code of Ordinances entitled: “Traffic and Vehicles.”

Ordained by the Mayor and Council of the Town of Sharpsburg, this the 14th day of September, 2020 by the following voting for adoption.
